hints.title: Individual Word Inversion
hints.text: Whitespace characters and word sequence order remain fixed. Only the internal characters of each individual word reverse.

hints.title: Delimiter Preserving Reversal Invariant
hints.text: Splitting on single spaces and reversing each token individually before re-joining restores original inter-word spacing.

hints.title: Token Reversal Assembly Procedure
hints.text: Split the sentence by single space into words. Reverse the characters in each word. Join the inverted words back together using single spaces and return.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding the sentence character by character without tokenization requires manual index boundary bookkeeping.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tokenizing and reversing words processes characters in O(N) time with O(N) space for word arrays and results.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should preserve original single-space spacing and reverse characters within each word.
